audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup is built around a fabricated ability: 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' appears in winCon, enemyWin, loading, focus.text, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.feeding, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d and four report entries. The content layer also invents 'Fated Painting' and 'Countenance'.
audit.why: Hwei's crowd-control palette is Subject: Torment (E, 12s), and its spells are Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss and Crushing Maw. There is no 'Subject: Fear', no 'Fated Painting' and no 'Countenance' in the kit. The packet flags that the page never names a single real Hwei ability.
audit.corrected: Every instance replaced with Subject: Torment and, where it fits, the specific spell names; Subject: Serenity named as the 18s shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[].side is 'Skill' on all seven rows; content win[] and the packet levelChart read Ekko on all seven.
audit.why: Hwei has no dash, blink or escape anywhere in the kit, and Ekko's Q out-ranges his lane pattern at 1075. 52.8% over 1589 games agrees with the content layer.
audit.corrected: All seven full rows moved to Ekko with whys rewritten to argue it from the kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: No spike anywhere on the page carried a cooldown, so 'level 6 is yours' was asserted rather than shown.
audit.why: Chronobreak is 110s against a 120s Spiraling Despair, and Subject: Serenity's shield returns only every 18s — those two numbers are the spikes.
audit.corrected: phases[4], phases[5], cooldowns and spikes[1].text now carry them.

audit.why: It is the field that must hold real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Now carries Subject: Torment 12s, Subject: Serenity 18s, Spiraling Despair 120s, Chronobreak 110s.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string and dontsFull[2].d the tradeBad string under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED x2); nothing on the page mentioned that Signature of the Visionary detonates after any two of his spells land.
audit.why: Riot's passive text: a second damaging spell completes the signature, which then detonates. That is what actually punishes a long trade here, and the missingInteractions entry flags the Serenity shield on top of it.
audit.corrected: Both bullets rewritten to their own titles; the signature and the 18s shield now stated in the trade fields.

notes: This matchup was written around an ability that does not exist. 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' is fabricated — the real palette is Subject: Torment (E, 12s), holding Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss and Crushing Maw. 'Fated Painting' and 'Countenance' are likewise fabricated. All twelve instances replaced. Two report entries rewritten (report[1].t, report[5].t) under the naming-a-fabricated-ability exception; report[3].t and report[9].t still carry 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' and MUST be swept — they are outside the two-report cap but they are the same fabrication. Content win[] already matched the packet chart, so no paired win[N] edit exists for the side moves. packet.suspectNames flags 'Use Chronobreak' in wants.you[2] — that is Ekko's own R and a FALSE POSITIVE.
